Requirements: Python ≥ 3.10 with `mujoco`, `numpy`, `opencv-python`, "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"`matplotlib`, `pytest` (the Anaconda `python3.10` env is recommended)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Output lands in `examples/demo-output/`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Artifact | What it is |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `report-run-*.md` | experiment report with evidence and hypotheses |
| `timeline-run-*.html` | sta"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ndalone timeline viewer (open in any browser, no server) |

| `dashboard.html` | single-file dashboa"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"rd over the run store |
| `.rh/runs/*/artifacts/*.png` | the charts shown above |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## 🏗️ Architecture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Every tool in the bundle delegates to the Python worker over stdio (`python -m robotic_harness_worke"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"r <command> --input -`). Runs, telemetry, charts and reports are written to the workspace's `.rh/` d"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"irectory by default. One-shot processes give crash isolation: a worker failure never takes down DSH."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## ⚠️ Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"> Stated honestly, so testers are never surprised."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- The suction grasp is a **kinematic implementation** (the object follows the cup while attached) — "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"noted in run configs and reports.
- Perception uses real offscreen rendering when the renderer is av"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ailable; otherwise it degrades to ground-truth + noise simulation (recorded in telemetry). If OpenCV"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" crashes natively (e.g., DLL conflicts in exotic environments), perception degrades to the same fall"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"back instead of failing the run. Headless Linux needs a software GL (`sudo apt install libosmesa6 li"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"bgl1` + `MUJOCO_GL=osmesa`) for offscreen rendering; the CI runs this way.
- Live ROS 2 tools requir"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"e the `ros2` CLI; without it they return a structured `backend: "unavailable"` diagnostic. rosbag2 i"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"nspection/conversion works without ROS.
- Real-robot tools are a state machine + preflight only: har"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"dware items are reported as `skip` (never faked) until a hardware adapter exists. Simulation results"},{"id":"p25s10","text":" are not real-robot evidence; there is no arbitrary topic-publish, real-robot write, or e-stop-relea"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"se capability.
- SolidWorks files are registered in inventories but not parsed (commercial software)"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"; FreeCAD deep integration is optional.
- RLDS export produces a manifest skeleton (full TFDS export"},{"id":"p25s13","text":" requires tensorflow); LeRobot export uses parquet when pyarrow is present, CSV otherwise.
- Literat"},{"id":"p25s14","text":"ure search and dataset discovery are best-effort network calls: when the API is unreachable they ret"},{"id":"p25s15","text":"urn a structured `backend: "unavailable"` result instead of fabricating papers or datasets.
- Traini"},{"id":"p25s16","text":"ng tools are workflow scaffolding: the generated training script is a deterministic template placeho"},{"id":"p25s17","text":"lder (not real model code), remote submission requires an explicitly configured server plus your con"},{"id":"p25s18","text":"firmation, and only allowlisted commands run remotely."}],"truncated":true}
